question:
Section Six: Paragraph Coherence
DIRECTIONS: When put in the correct order, the sentences in items 93 - 96 make complete and coherent paragraphs. From the alternatives A-D given in each case, choose the letter that shows the correct order of the sentences

A. One problem in relation to city buses is that a bus that should arrive at 7:30 in the morning may not arrive until 8: 00 or later.

B. Unfortunately, many people are often late for work or miss important appointments.

C. Poor public transportation system is a big in our city.

D. Moreover, bus drivers often pass up groups of people waiting for the bust at the bus stops.
explanation: Start with the main idea (C), give a specific example (A), add another supporting detail (D), then state the consequence (B).

question:
A. At the beginning, my elder sister used to go to gymnastics lessons and showed me how to do some gymnastics when she practiced at home.

B. Now, I take part in gymnastics practice every Saturday.

C. Thus, gymnastics is very special to me, especially because it is something I share with my sister.

D. I started gymnastics when I was six years old and it has been my favourite hobby since then.
explanation: Start with when the writer began gymnastics (D), explain how the sister helped (A), mention current practice (B), and conclude with why it is special (C).

question:
A. Similarly, smoking is linked to other lung diseases such as bronchitis.

B. The link between smoking and cancer is well known.

C. Furthermore, there is substantial research evidence that even passive smoking can have long term effects on health.

D. In addition to lung diseases, smokers have a greater risk of heart disease later in life.
explanation: The paragraph order starts with one reason (B: lower cost of living), another reason (D: less crime), then a general topic sentence (C), and finally another example (A: better jobs).

question:
A. Some people move to find better jobs.

B. Others want to move to a place with a lower cost of living.

C. There are many reasons why people go to other places to live.

D. Still others want to move to a place with less crime.
explanation: Start with the topic sentence (C) introducing the idea, then give examples: moving for jobs (A), lower cost of living (B), and less crime (D).
